parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of accelerated domain names per page. Valid values: **1** to **500**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: QueryArgs
parameters.description: The query conditions for a fuzzy search of accelerated domain names. The value must be a JSON string. For example: {"DomainNameLike":"example.com"}
